description: Expected output event sequence for Kotoba TTS v1.9 (promptless, one-shot) with timestamps enabled when synthesizing 'こんにちは、世界。今日もよろしくお願いします。' with response_id='resp_001'

events._comment: Sent by the server in response to the client's open event (after language and speaker_id are validated). `voice_settings` echoes the session defaults (from open, or speed 1.0 / pitch 0 / volume 1.0). `client_id` is the server-assigned session identifier.

Emitted in response to response.create. `response.id` is the id supplied by the client, or a server-generated UUID if it was omitted. The same id appears on every subsequent audio.chunk and on response.done.

Early streaming audio delta. `audio` is base64-encoded float32 (little-endian). `response_id` lets the client correlate chunks back to the originating response.create. No timestamp record has been finalized yet, so this chunk omits `alignments` entirely.
Newly finalized records appear exactly once in `alignments`. Their text concatenates to a prefix of the raw request text.
The final chunk carries the last newly finalized records in `alignments`; the records received across all chunks concatenate to the full request text.
End of this synthesis turn. The session stays open; a new response.create may follow.

cancelled._comment: `usage` reflects tokens consumed before cancellation (partial); omitted entirely if nothing was consumed.

failed_unknown_speaker._comment: No `usage`: this failure occurs before any audio is produced, so nothing was consumed. A failure mid-synthesis carries partial `usage`.

worker_timeout._comment: Non-fatal notification that the server did not produce audio within WS_RESULT_TIMEOUT. The session stays open and synthesis may be retried. After WS_RESULT_TIMEOUT_LIMIT (default 3) consecutive timeouts the server emits a fatal `error` and closes the connection. The `message` field is the literal string the server sends.

invalid_voice_settings._comment: Non-fatal, response-scoped rejection of a response.create whose voice_settings has a field out of range or not a number; `message` names the field. No response.created or response.done follows for this id; the session stays open.

timestamps_text_too_long._comment: Non-fatal, response-scoped rejection of a response.create with with_timestamps: true whose text is longer than 400 characters. No response.created or response.done follows for this id; the session stays open.
timestamps_text_too_long.message: with_timestamps supports text up to 400 characters

length_limited._comment: The response reached the model's output length limit. It still ends as completed; the audio already sent is kept.

fatal_error._comment: Fatal, session-scoped: the server closes the connection after it.
